text: Below is a brief editorial description of Lady Bass and my recommendation as to
whether or not this publication is of interest to Philip Morris. After you have reviewed
my comments, please give me your feedback. As stated in Sheila's April 24, 1990
letter (re: Media Kits), if we agree not to recommend this publication, I shall send a
rejection letter to the publication. Should we feel that a publication merits further
evaluation, please forward the kits to the appropriate coordinator.
Official publication of Lady Bass, a sports publication
directed towards women in bass fishing. Bi-monthly,
Not recommended - low circulation; grainy black & white
